  "title": "Ability to see when adblock filters were last updated; button to manually update adblock filters",
  "body": "<!-- Welcome! Thanks for taking time to submit a feature request.\r\nHave you searched the issue tracker? https://github.com/bromite/bromite/issues\r\nHave you read the F.A.Q.s? https://github.com/bromite/bromite/blob/master/FAQ.md\r\nHave you read the README? https://github.com/bromite/bromite/blob/master/README.md\r\nHave you read the Wiki? https://github.com/bromite/bromite/wiki\r\n-->\r\n\r\n<!-- Do not submit feature requests for extensions support or adding a search engine. -->\r\n\r\n### Is your feature request related to privacy?\r\n\r\nYes, since it allows users to see if their adblock filters file is out of date. \r\n\r\n### Is there a patch available for this feature somewhere?\r\n\r\nNo\r\n\r\n### Describe the solution you would like\r\n\r\nI would like to see a date when adblock filters we last updated and a button to manually update them if they are quite out of date to give users more control over their local filters. \r\n\r\n### Describe alternatives you have considered\r\n\r\nCan't think of any alternative. \r\n",

      "body": "@uazo interested in this? We already have a settings page for the URL, the information/button could be added there"

      "author": "Participant 1",
      "body": "@csagan5 thank you for considering my feature request. A couple of related questions, if I may?\r\n\r\n1) Is your .dat file the only one that can be used on Bromite or are there others that can be used in place of it? I can't find any others when Googling. I ask because I see ads when I browse apkmirror.com on Bromite v87 which has very simple Google ads and I wanted to test if my current filters weren't working by comparing to other filterlists.\r\n\r\n2) Can you remove Reek from the adblock lists as that is not maintained since 2016?"
    },

      "body": "> 2. Can you remove Reek from the adblock lists as that is not maintained since 2016?\r\n\r\nThis filter is indeed not maintained since a while, but when I keep it checked (via uBO extension) it blocks some sites anti-adblock notices."
